# lambdasoft

> A product engineering team for the AI era. We design, build and ship
> software: web, mobile and desktop applications, the cloud infrastructure
> they run on, and the agentic and generative AI inside them.

lambdasoft is a new studio. We take a single discipline or the whole build,
from first sketch to production. There is no client roster to quote yet, and
we would rather say that than invent one.

## What we do

- **Software engineering**: web, mobile and desktop applications. TypeScript from the database to the browser, native where the platform genuinely matters.
- **Cloud and infrastructure**: containers, CI that runs the tests before a merge, and infrastructure as code so any environment rebuilds from the repository alone.
- **Agentic and generative AI**: autonomous agents that plan and call your tools, retrieval over your own documents, and the evaluations that show it helped.
- **Security**: authentication and authorisation done properly, secrets kept out of the repository, dependencies monitored, least-privilege access by default.

## Why teams work with us

Designed for scale, natively global, direct access to the engineers doing the
work, an ecosystem you can extend, built for the AI era, and design judgement
applied as seriously as engineering.
